Full equilibrium data, auxiliary atomic/VO/EuO values, temperature interval and covariance still need reconstruction. Do not treat later reevaluations as independent experiments.

entries.inspection: Full online evaluation; publication/revision date not securely established
findings: Reevaluates isomolecular Balducci1983 equilibria VO2+V=2VO and VO2+Eu=EuO+VO; favours pressure ratios over absolute pressures; D0=1166+-12 kJ/mol, Hf298=-160.259+-12.3 kJ/mol.
No new independent measurement relative to Balducci1983. Updated auxiliary data and thermal functions matter.

Its description that JANAF omits excited electronic states agrees with the inspected original page. The atomic V++ level analogy and a hypothetical VO2 state in the JANAF uncertainty discussion must not be mistaken for adopted levels.
Its older0.6eV state assignment follows Wu/Wang1998 and predates the2014 cryo-SEVI reassignment.

entries.role: Primary cryogenic anion photoelectron experiment with calculations
findings: Assigned neutral bent X2A1 ground state, A2B1 at0.1845(8)eV and B2A1 at0.8130(5)eV; v1/v2 measured separately in all three states.
EA1.8357(5)eV revises the2.03(1)eV assignment in Wu/Wang1998; electron affinity is not neutral atomization energy.
Cryogenic ion preparation and resolved distinct progressions reduce hot-anion ambiguities; the third band needs configuration interaction.
No v3 measurement, complete high-temperature partition function, state-specific rotational measurement or formation enthalpy supplied.
DFT/CASPT2/RCCSD(T) study proposes alternate assignments involving near-degenerate anion states.
The assignment dispute is retained, not silently treated as agreement.
